sn56.20:1.3: idaṃ dukkhanti bhikkhave, tathametaṃ avitathametaṃ anaññathametaṃ.
sn56.20:1.6: ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti tathametaṃ avitathametaṃ anaññathametaṃ.
sn56.20:1.7: imāni kho bhikkhave, cattāri tathāni avitathāni anaññathāni.
sn56.20:2.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo, ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yogo karaṇīyo. ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yogo karaṇīyo. ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
